data.action: 端坐于战术展开的轮椅上，手抚长管重型狙击铳，目光沉着锐利
data.camera: medium shot, low angle, mounted rifle and wheelchair supports visible
data.description: 【蕾缪安 · 靶场】战术射击靶场内，蕾缪安端坐于展开战术支架的特制轮椅上，纤细的手指沉稳地抚过长管重型狙击铳的枪机，目光瞬间变得极其锐利——「即便身处轮椅之上，在两千米外的距离内，我的子弹也绝对不会允许任何威胁靠近你半步。」
data.promptProse: Lemuen rests her hand on the bolt of the long sniper rifle mounted beside her tactical wheelchair, its stabilizing supports unfolded against the ground. Harsh daylight draws a bright edge along the barrel as she studies the range.
data.title: 蕾缪安 · 靶场
data.animaCaption: Her hand rests on the rifle bolt beside the wheelchair's unfolded stabilizing supports.
